title: NIN Modification Portal: How to Correct Your NIN Details Online
excerpt: Made a mistake during your NIMC registration? Discover how to modify your NIN name, date of birth, and phone number online using Ufriends IT and skip NIMC queues.

sections.content: Your National Identification Number (NIN) is permanently tied to your biometrics. If there is an error in your name spelling, or if your date of birth is incorrect, it will affect you during bank updates, passport applications, and exam registrations like WAEC or JAMB. Having incorrect details on your NIN slip can completely stall your personal, academic, and financial progress in Nigeria. A single misplaced alphabet or incorrect year of birth can lock you out of key government services and bank account upgrades. This database serves as the bedrock of all identity validations in the nation, matching biometric entries with database records.

Fortunately, the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) allows citizens to modify their details. While visiting a NIMC office is the traditional route, long queues, bureaucratic delays, and network issues have made online processing through licensed portals like Ufriends IT a much more attractive option. This comprehensive guide will walk you through the online modification process, explain the legal requirements, and show you how to get your details corrected without stress. By leveraging modern verification pipelines, you can now manage your identity data securely from the comfort of your home, saving valuable hours.

Identity validation systems in Nigeria have evolved rapidly. With the integration of database cross-checks between banks, telcos, and immigration authorities, a minor typo that was ignored years ago will now trigger immediate flags. Correcting these errors at the source—the NIMC central database—is the only permanent resolution to account blocks and service restrictions. As database filters become tighter, keeping your profiles aligned is essential to prevent sudden transaction locks.

Furthermore, many people find it difficult to understand the complex terms used by government portals. Words like 'demographic harmonization' or 'biometric mapping' can be confusing. Our guide breaks down these processes into plain, simple language that anyone, including parents updating records for their children or elderly citizens correcting historical spelling errors, can easily follow.

sections.content: What is NIN Modification on Ufriends IT?

NIN modification on Ufriends IT is a secure digital service that updates your registered details (such as Name, Date of Birth, or Phone Number) in the central NIMC database. Because your fingerprints and photo are already registered, you do not need to undergo biometric capture again. The portal acts as a secure link, submitting your verified legal documents and details online, allowing verification officers to update your central profile centrally. This service bypasses the need for physical queues, transport stress, and manual filing delays.

Instead of waiting in physical halls, you submit your legal documents and details online. The Ufriends IT portal verifies the information, uploads the files, and updates your central profile, syncing it across the national database. This is a game-changer for Nigerians who want to avoid crowded government offices. Once the update is saved, the new details will show up on all government verification queries, letting you resolve account issues instantly.
The NIN Modification Agreement: What You Must Know
Because identity updates are highly secure, Ufriends IT requires all users to read and accept the NIN Modification Agreement before submitting a request. Here are the key terms you should know:

items: Voluntary Authorization: By submitting, you confirm that you voluntarily authorize the platform to proceed with the modification on your behalf (particularly if you find the official portal difficult to use due to technical errors or server lags).

Alias Emails: Ufriends IT uses secure alias email addresses for NIN updates. This is used strictly for database login. If you prefer to use your own personal email, you can request an email update directly from NIMC after the modification is complete.

Update Delays: When changes are saved, the updates reflect immediately on the NIMC central registry and the immigration passport portal. However, commercial banks and SIM card providers do not read real-time data—it takes longer for them to sync their local systems. If you are modifying your NIN primarily for banking purposes and cannot afford to wait for these updates, we advise you not to proceed.

sections.content: Required Documents for NIN Modification
To prove that the requested changes are legitimate, you must provide supporting documentation. Collect the relevant documents before starting to prevent processing rejections:

items: For Name Changes: A Sworn Affidavit signed by a commissioner for oaths, a newspaper change of name publication page, a marriage certificate (for married women), and a supporting ID (like a BVN printout or voter's card). The names must be spelled identically across all pages.

For Date of Birth Changes: A Sworn Affidavit (declaration of age) and a verified birth certificate from the National Population Commission (NPC). (NIMC enforces a strict rule: you can only modify your DOB once in your lifetime).
For Phone Number changes: A SIM registration pack, a SIM swap receipt from your telecom provider, or a court affidavit of SIM ownership verifying the line belongs to you.

sections.content: The Strict NPC Birth Certificate Rule

If you are correcting your date of birth, NIMC will not accept a hospital card or a handwritten declaration. You must provide an official certificate issued by the National Population Commission (NPC). If you were born before 1992, you must obtain an NPC Attestation of Birth Certificate, which is available at NPC desks inside local government secretariats. Without this document, age modifications will be rejected by database validators, as handwritten papers are easily manipulated. The NPC is the sole legal authority recognized for certifying births and age validations in Nigeria. This ensures the integrity of the national population data is preserved.

sections.content: The Slower Alternative: Visiting a Physical NIMC Center

If you choose to modify your details physically, you must visit a NIMC enrollment office or a licensed private kiosk. You must generate a Remita RRR code online, pay the official fee (₦500 for name/phone changes or ₦15,000 for DOB changes) at a bank branch, bring your physical documents, and wait in line for an enrollment officer to process your request. For DOB updates, you are required to visit a State Headquarters NIMC office, as local offices cannot process age changes. This route is often slow and subject to local network and power issues, meaning it could take several trips to complete, resulting in transport costs and time drainage. If you live in remote areas, this travel can be highly demanding.
What Happens After Submission?

Once your request is submitted, Ufriends IT processes the verification and submits the update to the central NIMC database. Demographic updates like name or phone corrections reflect in 24 to 72 hours, while Date of Birth changes require manual auditing by NIMC database administrators and can take **5 to 15 working days** to reflect centrally. You can check the transaction history on your dashboard to monitor the status of your query. Our admin desk is always available to review and escalate stuck queries.
Checking Your NIN Verification Status

After the standard processing timeline, you should verify if the changes have reflected centrally. You can do this by printing a standard or premium NIN slip directly on Ufriends IT. Alternatively, you can use the NIMC mobile app to check your profile. If the details show your correct name or birth year, the database update is complete. If the old details still show up, the server sync might be delayed; check back in 24 hours. Once complete, you can confidently present your new slip to your bank to lift restrictions.
Common Mistakes to Avoid
To prevent rejections, avoid these common mistakes when modifying your NIN details:

items: Paying Unverified Agents: Many social media scammers claim they can modify your NIN database details in minutes. NIMC uses secure biometrics; only authorized portals like Ufriends IT can securely transmit your requests.
Duplicate Enrollment: Never attempt to register for a second NIN to fix errors. The central system will detect your duplicate biometrics, block both records, and flag your profile for fraud.
Mismatched Document Details: Ensure the names on your court affidavit match the spelling on your supporting ID documents exactly. A mismatch of a single letter will cause NIMC to reject the request.
Uploading Dark or Blurry Documents: Automated scanners and human validators reject unreadable files. Ensure you capture clear, well-lit images of your affidavits and certificates.

sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

items: Can I modify my NIN details online? Yes, you can modify your NIN details (Name, DOB, or Phone Number) online using secure portals like Ufriends IT. You simply upload your documents, submit the request, and Ufriends handles the processing on the back-end.
How long does it take for a NIN change to reflect? Name and phone updates reflect in 24 to 72 hours, while DOB modifications take 5 to 15 working days.
What is the fee to change my details on Ufriends IT? Ufriends IT offers free basic accounts. You only pay standard processing fees for database updates and a simple 1% wallet funding fee.
Why was my DOB modification rejected? The most common reasons are submitting a hospital card instead of an NPC birth certificate, or submitting mismatched court affidavits.
Can I change my date of birth twice? No. NIMC enforces a strict policy: you can only modify your date of birth once in your lifetime.
What is the funding fee on Ufriends IT? Ufriends IT charges a simple 1% fee on automated virtual bank transfers, with funds crediting in under 15 seconds.
How do I check my updated details? Once approved, you can log into Ufriends IT, select 'Print NIN slip', and instantly download your updated slip showing your correct Name and DOB.
Can I use my own email address? Yes, but the platform uses alias email accounts for submission. You can update your email directly with NIMC after the modification is completed.
Will my banks automatically update? No, banks do not read real-time database updates. Once NIMC updates centrally, you must visit your banks to perform a manual profile revalidation.
Can I modify a minor's NIN? Yes, parents can submit modification requests for their children using Ufriends IT by providing the minor's NIN and correct birth certificates.
Is my personal data safe? Yes, Ufriends IT uses end-to-end data encryption to safeguard your uploaded affidavits, IDs, and personal records from data breaches.
What if my transaction is flagged as pending? If central NIMC servers lag, the Ufriends IT admin team processes your download manually, which completes in a few minutes.
Do I need to do biometrics again for name change? No, biometric recaptures are not required for demographic changes like name or birth date corrections.
Can I modify my state of origin online? Yes, you can correct your State or Local Government of Origin online by uploading a verified Certificate of Origin issued by your LGA secretariat.
